meta.audit_method: Government-related fields (QCO/mandatory status, editions) checked against official BIS / Government of India web sources. Editions cross-checked against BIS product manuals and public BIS document mirrors. Values that could not be established from an official source are marked UNVERIFIED / MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED - never silently promoted to verified.
primary_sources: https://www.bis.gov.in/product-certification/products-under-compulsory-certification/scheme-i-mark-scheme/ (official BIS Scheme-1 / ISI compulsory-certification list with QCO notifications)
https://archive.org/details/gov.in.is.* (public mirror of official BIS standard documents, used for edition/revision identification only)
meta.warning: This file is a point-in-time audit snapshot. QCOs are amended frequently. Re-verify before real procurement use.

qco.name: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (superseded by QCO 2024, S.O. 574(E) dated 05-02-2024; amendment order 2025 S.O. 5134(E))

Registry amendment 'Amendment 2' remains from curated data - amendment number not independently confirmed.

qco.name: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020/2024

notes: 'IS 1786:2008' appears verbatim on the official BIS compulsory-certification list.

IS 269.gov_edition: IS 269:2015 consistent with public BIS records; QCO list cites 'IS 269' without edition

qco.name: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003 - covers 'any kind of cement' manufactured or sold in India; registry note cites the 2023 Cement QCO which was not located on the BIS page fetched (2023 order may exist via a later notification - unconfirmed)

notes: Mandatory status is QCO-backed via the official BIS Scheme-1 list.
Registry note says 'Cement Quality Control Order 2023'; the fetched official page lists the 2003 order (S.O. 191(E)). The 2023 order reference needs manual confirmation.

IS 1489 (Part 1).gov_edition: IS 1489 (Part 1):2015 consistent with public BIS records
notes: PPC (fly ash based) is listed as item 3 on the official BIS Scheme-1 cement list.

IS 1489 (Part 2).gov_edition: IS 1489 (Part 2):2015 (Fourth Revision) - public BIS document mirror; registry previously said 1991
notes: DISCREPANCY FIXED: registry edition '1991' predated the current '2015 (Fourth Revision)'. Old value preserved in government_verification_report.json.
Registry amendment 'Reaffirmed 2020' belonged to the 1991-edition lineage and was removed pending confirmation of amendments to the 2015 edition.

IS 694.gov_edition: IS 694:2010 consistent with public BIS records; QCO list cites 'IS 694' without edition

qco.name: Electric Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order, 2003

notes: PVC insulated cables (item 29 on the official Scheme-1 list).

IS 383.gov_edition: IS 383:2016 confirmed via official BIS product manuals

qco.name: No Quality Control Order covering aggregates was found on the official BIS compulsory-certification list

notes: DISCREPANCY: registry claims mandatory certification, but IS 383 appears on BIS's official SIMPLIFIED-PROCEDURE (voluntary) list and no QCO covering aggregates was found. Aggregates are a raw material, not a marked product.
Application must not present IS 383 certification as mandatory until a QCO/notification is produced.

IS 1077.gov_edition: IS 1077:1992 (Fifth Revision) + Amendment 1 (2008) consistent with public BIS records; no newer edition located

qco.name: No QCO covering burnt clay bricks was located in official sources during this audit

notes: Registry mandatory claim has no located QCO backing - treat as MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

IS 4984.gov_edition: IS 4984:2016 (Fifth Revision) per official BIS book/product-manual listings; registry previously said 'Fourth Revision' with an HDPE-only title

qco.name: HDPE/PE pipes appear in BIS product manuals and ERL annual-report context referencing QCO implementation, but no QCO notification covering IS 4984 was located on the official compulsory-certification list during this audit

notes: DISCREPANCY FIXED: registry title/revision updated to the official BIS listing ('Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply - Specification', Fifth Revision).
Mandatory status cannot be confirmed or refuted from the fetched official page - MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED before claiming either way.
